risk_channels.g_model_struct: frozen pre-annotation layout structural flag score
risk_channels.d_cal_A: candidate distance to frozen C1 risk-design feature space; C1-only reference
risk_channels.d_cal_F: post-C2 confirmation distance; forbidden from C2-B selection

channel_use.risk_design_A: C2-B selection and simulation only; derived from d_model_feat, local LHFeat, g_model_struct and d_cal_A
channel_use.risk_route: V1 only after confirmed C2-B evidence

feature_freeze.preprocess: RGB/255, HoHoNet.extract_feat(), frozen reference PCA/whitening cache

simulation.selection: minimum non-dominated design satisfying approved post-C1 thresholds; no default CI cutoff
